detail.longDescription: How to deploy Redis in Kubernetes with Helm chart + Redis Commander (2026) Updated October 2026. Rewritten from scratch around the official Valkey Helm chart and a Redis 8 cluster on a plain StatefulSet. Every command below was tested on Kubernetes 1.36 with Helm 3.21. There are now two sane ways to run Redis in Kubernetes, and this post covers both: Option 1: Valkey with its official Helm chart. Valkey is the Linux Foundation fork of Redis 7.2, BSD licensed and protocol compatible, so redis-cli and every Redis client library talk to it unchanged.
